name: Regular Planning Commission Meeting - Adjourned
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF ADJOURNMENT

The July 21, 2020 regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Artesia has
been adjourned, due to lack of quorum, to 6:30 p.m. on August 18, 2020, at the Albert O.
Little Community Center 18750 Clarkdale Ave., Artesia, California 90701.

___July 20, 2020_________  ____________________________________
Date  Fiona Graham, Interim Planning Manager
